set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Turn volume-to-surface sampling into reusable sparse operators rather than eager sampled values. Acceptance: midpoint support uses SurfaceGeometryPair, ribbon support samples normalized white-to-pial weights with optional masks, operators expose adjoints for backprojection, SurfaceSampling eager API remains compatible, and shared JVM+JS tests cover toy meshes.
set.title: Volume-to-surface sampled operators
